items.title: Yunnan turns tea into tourist trade
items.description: On the slopes of Pu'er's Jingmai Mountain, tea comes in more than just a steaming cup. In Nuogan village, Dai ethnic entrepreneur Xianjin sells her signature Pu'er tea in an ice cream cone. Nearby, a Blang ethnic tea grower and a Dai businessman have joined forces, serving each other's traditional tea under one roof.
